name: touch: a press inside the Adjust panel starts a swipe
why: org/image-handling.org Housekeeping. The panel lies on the stage; without the guard a finger dragging a slider 120 px is read as a swipe, the picture steps (here back to 16 / 16) and the adjustment is reset.
grep: Adjust: a finger dragging a slider

name: touch: a swipe in Compare steps the left picture
why: A plain step moves st.i, the LEFT picture; ← → and the filmstrip change the right one. The swipe must go through _artViewerCompareStep().
grep: Compare: a swipe changes the right picture

name: touch: a finger going down does not place the lens
why: Touch fires no mousemove while a finger slides, so without the pointerdown branch the lens never shows on a phone and the finger swipes instead.
grep: Loupe: one finger moves the lens

name: touch: the lens does not follow a sliding finger
why: The pointermove branch moves the lens with the finger; without it the lens stays where the finger went down.
grep: Loupe: one finger moves the lens

name: touch: the loupe takes the finger also when it is off
why: _artViewerLoupeTouch() must ask st.loupe: with the loupe off a one-finger move is a swipe again (the test's control).
grep: Loupe: one finger moves the lens
